title: Tokyo Hash launches 貸暗号資産
description: Tokyo Hash announced that applications for its crypto-asset lending service would begin on 2021-12-15. The service was described as a consumption-loan arrangement with return of the same type/equivalent quantity plus contractual lending fees after the lending period.
notes: First-party launch authority. Current branding is HashKey Japan; this event preserves the launch-era Tokyo Hash name without inventing a later rebrand/legal-transition date.
